model: BrHCl_LEPS1 historical ground-state Br-H-Cl London-Eyring-Polanyi-Sato PES
upstream_license: ChemPotPy repository Apache-2.0; preserve upstream attribution. Source is fetched into ignored build/, not bundled or relicensed as PyRPMD MIT.
energy_zero: Br + HCl at the model HCl equilibrium distance and infinite Br separation
scope: A published historical analytic reaction model with HBr, HCl and BrCl asymptotic arrangements. Its original parameter studies focused on Br+HCl hydrogen transfer; this does not establish modern quantitative accuracy for H+BrCl branching.
precision_note: The unchanged upstream DOUBLE PRECISION source is compiled with ordinary GNU Fortran kinds, without default-real promotion. The wrapper calls PREPOT/POT in atomic units and avoids the ChemPotPy pes entry's rounded angstrom/eV conversions. Its rounded internal sqrt(2)=1.41421356 is preserved; the nominal equilibrium asymptote zero consequently differs by less than 1e-9 hartree.
